classification_rationale: The customer is asking how to return a tower light at the end of its rental, either by collection or drop-off, a standard return-logistics question.

draft.reply_body:
Hello,

Thanks for letting us know the LED tower light is ready to come back. Either option works — we can arrange collection from your site, or you're welcome to drop it off at the Kempele depot yourselves, whichever suits you better.

Let us know which you'd prefer and, if it's collection, a good day and time window, and we'll get it arranged.

Once it's checked in and confirmed undamaged and complete, your deposit will be refunded in full within five working days.

Best regards,
Haapaharju Oy Customer Service

commitments.description: Confirm both return options are available: site collection or drop-off at the Kempele depot
